invariantTrace.claim: No missing/unmaterializable <video> can coexist with unresolvedElementAssets = 0
pathsChecked: video + own video-kind asset with url -> src = video url, kind === 'video', unresolved false. CORRECT.
video + video-kind asset whose url is undefined, poster present -> choosePrimary skips url-less candidates, falls to video-poster, src = poster url, videoContentUnresolved true -> counted. CORRECT.
video + poster only (no video-kind asset at all) -> src = poster url (render byte-identical to before), videoContentUnresolved true -> counted. CORRECT.
video + 2+ ambiguous video-kind candidates -> choosePrimary returns {ambiguous:true} and does NOT fall through to poster -> no src -> noSrcAtAll -> counted. CORRECT.
video + assetRefs that are all dangling ids -> assets [] -> no src -> noSrcAtAll -> counted. CORRECT.

video with 0 assetRefs and no <source> child -> resolver returns unresolved false (empty-refs branch is still img-only), compile-node's videoHasNoOwnAssetAndNoSourceChild catches it -> counted. CORRECT. 4 such elements exist in the corpus (2 linear.app, 2 stripe.com) and were previously invisible.
video with 0 assetRefs and a <source> child whose own assetRefs resolve -> not counted at the parent, child resolves. CORRECT.
video with 0 assetRefs and a <source> child whose assetRefs do NOT resolve -> the child is counted via the new tagName 'source' extension. CORRECT.

remainingSilentPath.shape: <video><source src=...></video> where the <source> itself produced ZERO assetRefs (its src/srcset failed URL resolution in the Observer, or it carries only type/media attributes).
remainingSilentPath.why: AssetResolver.resolve() empty-assetRefs branch still returns unresolved = (tagName === 'img'), AND compile-node's asset block is only entered when assetRefs.length > 0 || img || svg || video - so a 0-assetRef <source> is never evaluated at all. The parent <video> is simultaneously treated as innocent because a <source> child exists. Both ends stay silent.
remainingSilentPath.evidence: All 174 <source> elements across the 6-site corpus carry at least one assetRef (tmp/wr285b/verify-video/silent.ts: srcNoRefs = 0).
remainingSilentPath.suggestedFix: extend the empty-assetRefs branch to `tagName === 'img' || tagName === 'source'`, or add `|| tagName === 'source'` to the compile-node block-entry condition.

defects.shape: <video> that carries a NON-media assetRef (background-image / mask-image / icon - collect-assets.ts pushes background-image for EVERY element, outside the tagName switch) while supplying its media through <source> children.
defects.effect: assetRefs.length > 0, so compile-node's videoHasNoOwnAssetAndNoSourceChild guard (which requires assetRefs.length === 0) does not apply; resolve('video', [bgAsset]) finds no PRIMARY_IMAGE_KINDS match and no srcset -> noSrcAtAll -> unresolved true. The element renders correctly from its <source> child but is counted unresolved. The guard is asymmetric: it protects the standard <video><source> pattern only when the video has exactly zero assetRefs.
defects.evidence: video assetRef kind shapes across the whole corpus are only {video+video-poster: 12, video: 14, none: 4} - no video element currently carries a background-image/mask-image asset.
defects.suggestedFix: compute the source-child signal in compile-node unconditionally (not only when assetRefs.length === 0) and suppress the video unresolved flag when a resolvable <source> child exists.

defects.detail: The handoff frames the change as accounting-only ('poster handling is unchanged; only its honesty changed'). That is true ONLY for the poster-ONLY substitution path (0 occurrences in the corpus). Adding 'video' to PRIMARY_IMAGE_KINDS materially changes RENDERED output for 26 of the corpus's 30 <video> elements: 14 videos that previously emitted no src at all now emit their real media url, and 12 videos that previously emitted their POSTER image url as <video src> (undecodable as video) now emit the real media url. Both are strict improvements and are the intended root-cause fix, but they are render changes, not accounting changes, and downstream visual-fidelity/QA baselines for linear.app and stripe.com will shift.

<audio> elements take the generic fall-through return in resolve(): no src is ever emitted and unresolved is never set, so audio media is silently dropped exactly the way video was. 2 such elements with assetRefs exist in the corpus. Outside this task's scope; recorded so it is not lost.

sideEffectAudit.pictureSourceRisk: no-false-positive-observed; structurally bounded to genuine failures
sideEffectAudit.evidence: Old-vs-new differential over the latest site-spec of all 6 sites (tmp/wr285b/verify-video/oldnew.ts): 174 elements (168 of them stripe.com ), sourceSrcDiff = 0, srcSet diffs = 0, sourceUnresDiff = 0. Not one real changes its src, its srcSet, or its unresolved flag. Structural reason: the Observer pushes kind 'picture-source' for every srcset candidate whose URL resolves and kind 'source' for a resolvable src, so a reaches buildSrcSet with usable candidates and produces a srcSet value -> noSrcAtAll is false -> unresolved stays false. A can only newly flag when it yields NEITHER a primary src NOR a srcset value, which requires either url-less assets or the multi-candidate all-descriptorless srcset-truncation artifact - i.e. the source genuinely failed to produce anything renderable. The AssetCatalog's canonicalKey is JSON.stringify([type, url, descriptor]), so an asset id's kind is bound to its type and a 'video'/'video-poster' asset can never alias onto an / (measured: crossKindImgOrSourceWithVideoAsset = 0).
sideEffectAudit.quantifiedRisk: Only when the source's asset genuinely failed to produce a src or a srcset. Cost when it fires: the fallback of the still renders, so unresolvedElementAssets counts one element whose picture is visually fine - a per-element overcount, never a wrong render.
sideEffectAudit.judgment: Not a defect. The extension to tagName 'source' is required for the <video><source> case and is inert on the entire real corpus. No smoke suite outside scripts/smoke-video-honesty.ts asserts unresolvedElementAssets or elementAssetsRequested (verified by grep across scripts/ and src/; only src/cli-reconstruct.ts prints them and src/reconstruction/generate-app.ts + compile-runtime-page.ts pass them through), so nothing measurable regressed.

imageSourceRenderUnchanged.evidence: 2,914 and 174 nodes across 6 sites: 0 src differences, 0 srcSet differences, 0 unresolved-flag differences between the pre-change and post-change resolver. The poster-substitution path itself is byte-identical: with no video-kind candidate present, choosePrimary still selects video-poster and still writes that url to src; only `unresolved` changed. compile-node still writes props['src']/props['srcSet'] only when resolved.src/srcSet are defined, so the widened block-entry condition adds no props for a 0-assetRef
